name: dev-dashboard
description: Docked pane showing the project, branch, upstream, worktrees, recent commits, the last turn's recap and the session's context fill.

art.title: Pane artwork
art.description: flower draws the six-petal flower above the banner as colored cells (terminal only); none draws nothing.

banner.title: Banner text
banner.description: Drawn as block letters at the top of the pane (letters, digits, - and .). Empty draws none; one too wide for the pane is skipped.

commits.title: Commits shown
commits.description: How many recent commits the pane lists.

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself when the terminal is fullscreen and wide enough. /dashboard opens it at any width.

pollSeconds.title: Git poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the git facts are re-read while the session idles, for commits made outside the session. 0 turns polling off.

recapLines.title: Recap lines
recapLines.description: How many lines of the last answer the recap keeps.

theme.title: Pane colors
theme.description: auto follows Claude Code's theme setting; light and dark force a palette.
